desc:
🧠 Welcome to Steal A Head!

How to Play:
🏃 Sneak into stages and steal NPC heads!
👮 Escape the stage Bosses before they catch you!
🧠 Bring stolen heads back to your base!
🌱 Plant your heads and watch them GROW!
🤖 Collect your heads to unlock unique NPCs!
💰 Earn money from your NPCs!
⚡ Upgrade your Speed and unlock new stages!
🥚 Discover rare heads, HUGE sizes, and mutations!
😈 Steal heads from other players!

🏆 Can you collect the RAREST and BIGGEST NPCs?
